census.note: The paper's 71-file census counts structure labels only; Atlas.nii.gz whole-brain mask files (13) are counted separately here.

paper_census.reconciliation: This recount voxel-checked all 71 files: 48 real / 23 empty. The sealed 53/18 (processing_log 2026-11-16, from the Goldmine Hunter sweep, species-sweep-20261116-230812.json) voxel-checked only 56 of the 71 files - every checked file agrees with this recount (39 real / 17 empty, zero disagreements) - plus the Galago hippocampus called out empty in the same log (= 18 empty); the remaining 15 unchecked files were carried as real by subtraction (71 - 18 = 53). Five of those 15 are in fact zero-voxel Striatum files the sweep never checked (Baboon, Crab-eating macaque, Gorilla, Human, Rhesus macaque), which accounts exactly for the 53->48 and 18->23 differences.

flags: Census discrepancy vs paper p1: paper reports 53 real / 18 empty of 71 label files; full voxel recount gives 48 real / 23 empty - reconciled in census.paper_census (5 unchecked zero-voxel Striatum files carried as real in the sealed census).
